site.tagline: Private proofing galleries with a simple, calm client experience.
site.intro: Share a private gallery link, let clients favorite the frames they love, and deliver their finals from the same place when edits are done.
site.homepageHeadline: Proof, select, and deliver without chasing selections across text messages.
site.homepageSubhead: This starter site is intentionally lightweight: static pages, Google Drive delivery, direct client links, and zero paid backend required to get started.

clients.name: Sage + Owen
clients.clientNote: Welcome to your proof gallery. Tap the heart on any image you want edited first. Your choices stay on this device until you copy, download, or email them back.
clients.selectionInstructions: Choose your favorites, add any notes, then use the action buttons to send your selections back. Once edits are complete, the finals section becomes your delivery space.
